name: mcp-time-tracker
description: Track billable time without leaving your AI chat. Timers, entries, reports, CSV export and invoice line items, all stored locally.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: timer_start
tools.description: Start tracking time on a project. Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and logs the previous one.

tools.name: timer_stop
tools.description: Stop the running timer and log it as a time entry. Returns the duration and the entry id.

tools.name: timer_status
tools.description: Show the running timer, how long it has been running, and today's total so far.

tools.name: entry_add
tools.description: Log time you already worked. Give start plus either end or minutes.

tools.name: entry_list
tools.description: List logged time entries as a compact table. Free tier shows the last 7 days.

tools.name: entry_delete
tools.description: Delete one time entry by id.

tools.name: entry_edit
tools.description: Change fields of an existing entry. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: project_set_rate
tools.description: Set the hourly rate used to turn tracked hours into money for a project.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Total tracked hours and money for a period, grouped by project, day, task or tag. Free tier covers the last 7 days.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Write time entries to a CSV file you can hand to a bookkeeper or import into a spreadsheet. Free tier exports the last 7 days.

tools.name: invoice_summary
tools.description: Turn tracked time into invoice line items for one project: hours, rate, amount per task, plus the total.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
